name: Sigrika

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Gauntlets Echo Skill DMG DPS (similar archetype to Phrolova/Galbrena) built around generating and consuming 'Runes' via enhanced Basic Attacks and Skills to power a big Forte nuke. Considered the strongest Whimpering Wastes DPS in the game, but heavily reliant on Qiuyuan or Lucilla as Echo-focused teammates.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - One, Two, Three (4 hits) -> Basic Attack: Elucidated (Echo-Skill-DMG, in Decipher state, grants Rune: Trust).
skills.resonanceSkill: BOOMY BOOM! (base) / BIG BOOMY BOOM! (Decipher state, grants Rune: Answer).
skills.forte: Within Infinity's Embrace - governs Rune (max 4) consumption via Heavy Attack: Schemata of Runes (Outburst/Chain Whip/Soliskin variants) into the Forte finisher Learn My True Name.
skills.liberation: Where Trust Leads Me! - Echo-Skill-DMG hit, grants Divergent (next Rune also grants the opposite type).
skills.outro: In This Very Moment - 795% ATK Echo-Skill-DMG hit, grants Encapsulated (stagnates on ally Echo Skill casts).

bestWeapons: Legend of Drunken Hero (best gacha-free, needs Ciaccona active)
echoSet: Sound of True Name (100%, best - 20% CRIT Rate + 25% Aero DMG Bonus)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Qiuyuan and Lucilla are near-mandatory - Sigrika's damage is almost entirely Echo Skill DMG, which only they buff meaningfully.

teams.name: Phrolova Pairing
teams.notes: Both share Qiuyuan's Echo Skill casts for high tandem damage, excellent for Whimpering Wastes.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 2,3,4 -> Elucidated -> Heavy: Chain Whip (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Basic 2,3,4 -> Elucidated -> Heavy: Outburst (cancel via hold Skill) -> Hold Skill: Learn My True Name -> Outro. Advanced quickswap unlocks a 'Double Outburst' extended rotation.
communityNotes: Prydwen: one of the best overall DPS in the game and arguably the strongest Whimpering Wastes DPS, with built-in stun/grouping utility, but has a significant opportunity cost - near-mandatory reliance on Qiuyuan or Lucilla and no strong F2P weapon alternative, unlike Luuk Herssen or Aemeath.
